description:
Everything in your life…the wins, the setbacks, the detours you never would’ve chosen…isn’t random.

It’s all shaping you.
Stretching you.
Building the exact capacity you’ll need to hold what you say you want.

Nothing is wasted.
It’s all preparation.

You’re not behind.
You’re being built.
transcript: What if every single thing in your life was designed for you as a test to see if you really have the grit, the courage, the dedication to be the best version of you? And if you pass the test, you get to live the life that you deserve.
